name: Retro Gaming Symphony
description: An orchestra brings the unforgettable soundtracks of classic video games to life in a nostalgic and epic performance.
longDescription:
Retro Gaming Symphony is a musical event at Porto's Casa da Música on October 3, 2026. This performance features an orchestra dedicated to performing the iconic musical scores from a selection of classic video games. The event aims to celebrate the enduring impact of these compositions, presenting them in a live orchestral setting.

Attendees will hear orchestral renditions of well-known game themes within the grand architectural setting of Casa da Música. The performance is designed to evoke a sense of nostalgia for fans of retro gaming and to showcase the musical artistry within the medium. The event is suitable for a broad audience, including gamers and classical music enthusiasts.

Tickets for Retro Gaming Symphony are available, with pricing to be checked at the point of purchase. Casa da Música is located near the Casa da Música metro station, offering direct access via public transport.
